description:
A lightweight desktop AI client and screen-level agent: chat, tools, translation, OCR, and visual Q&A in one small app.

Kivio is a compact desktop AI client with a built-in agent runtime. It stays in the tray or menu bar, opens when you need it, and keeps a much smaller footprint than a browser-based AI workspace.
- Kivio Agent — chat, projects, assistants, memory, file/image attachments, MCP, Skills, and native tools (file ops, shell, web fetch/search, Pyodide run_python).
- Lens — screenshot-based visual Q&A, OCR, formula extraction, text polishing, and optional web-aware answers.
- Fast translation — typed text, selected text, windows, and arbitrary screen regions.
- Bring your own models — OpenAI-compatible providers and Anthropic Messages, with per-feature model routing and multi-key failover.
- Document-ready — PDF / Word / Excel workflows run on a bundled offline Pyodide sandbox, no first-run CDN download required.
- Private by default — no telemetry; API keys and conversation data stay on your machine.
Kivio Desktop v3.1.7
桌面 AI 助手 · macOS (Apple Silicon) + Windows。Desktop AI assistant for macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows.
下载 / Downloads
- Windows 安装包 / Installer — Kivio.Desktop_3.1.7_x64-setup.exe（NSIS）
- Windows 便携版 / Portable — Kivio.Desktop_3.1.7_x64-portable.zip，解压后运行 Kivio Desktop.exe / unzip and run.
  - 需要 Edge WebView2，设置和对话与安装版共用。Requires Edge WebView2; settings and conversations are shared with the installed app.
  - 应用内更新仍下载安装包；继续使用便携版请手动下载新 ZIP。In-app updates download the NSIS installer; download the new ZIP manually to remain portable.
- macOS — Kivio.Desktop_3.1.7_aarch64.dmg（Apple Silicon，未签名 / unsigned）
  - 首次启动：右键 → 打开，或运行 xattr -cr "/Applications/Kivio Desktop.app"。
  - First launch: right-click → Open, or run the command above.
新版本亮点 / What's New
以下是 v3.1.6 → v3.1.7 的变更。These changes cover v3.1.6 → v3.1.7.
- macOS 红黄绿按钮 / macOS window controls — 按实际 WebView 坐标对齐原生窗口按钮，改善失焦、缩放、页面切换及标题栏延迟加载后的定位。Align native window controls with the actual WebView coordinates and restore alignment after focus changes, resizing, navigation, and delayed titlebar mounting.
- 中文输入 / IME input — 修复输入法预编辑文字与输入框占位提示重叠。Hide the composer placeholder as soon as IME composition begins.
- CLI 账号与额度 / CLI accounts and usage — 主窗口和独立窗口新增 Codex、Claude Code 只读账号面板，按需显示套餐、剩余额度、重置时间与可用余额。Add an on-demand, read-only account panel for Codex and Claude Code, showing available plan, quota, reset, and credit information in both chat windows.
- 模型与服务等级 / Models and service tiers — 完整读取 Codex 模型目录，按模型能力处理图片并标注仅文本模型；支持 Codex 模型提供的服务等级选择及会话保存。Read the complete Codex model catalog, respect image capabilities, label text-only models, and persist supported Codex service-tier choices per conversation.
- 回复与交互同步 / Response and interaction synchronization — 修复最终正文缺失、重复或与草稿不一致；支持并行问答与审批，及时清理撤回或超时交互，避免子线程事件提前结束主对话。Reconcile final native text, handle concurrent questions and approvals, clear withdrawn or expired interactions, and isolate child-thread completion events.
- 运行中引导与恢复 / Steering and recovery — 改善 Claude 运行中指令的送达确认与前台子 Agent 协调；修正中断和失败判定、慢速切模确认及模型探测日志阻塞，保留续聊附件路径。Improve Claude steering receipts and foreground-agent coordination, correct cancellation and failure handling, tolerate slower model-switch acknowledgements, drain model-probe logs, and retain attachment paths in resumed turns.
- Git 初始化保护 / Git initialization safeguards — 初始化仓库前要求选择项目，并使用所选项目的实际路径，避免误在共享根目录初始化。Require a selected project and resolve its actual directory before initializing a repository to avoid initializing the shared root.
验证边界 / Validation limits
- 当前功能提交的 macOS 质量检查及 Windows Rust CI 已通过；Windows/WSL 桌面实机验收仍待完成。The feature commit passed macOS quality checks and Windows Rust CI; Windows/WSL desktop acceptance remains pending.
- Claude 运行中引导已通过协议替身验证，真实上游验收仍受服务过载影响，尚未完成。Claude steering passed controlled protocol validation; live upstream acceptance remains incomplete due to service overload.
完整变更 / Full changelog: https://github.com/ZMGID/kivio/compare/v3.1.6...v3.1.7
